senses.sense_definition: To officially enroll as a student at a college or university.

examples.text: Students must <w>matriculate</w> before they can register for their first semester of classes.
She decided to <w>matriculate</w> at the state university to pursue her degree in engineering.

senses.sense_definition: To join or enter a specific group or category of people.

examples.text: As new employees <w>matriculate</w> into the company, they undergo a rigorous training program.
Young professionals often <w>matriculate</w> into the workforce with high expectations for their careers.

senses.sense_definition: To complete a course of study or graduate from a school.

examples.text: Many students <w>matriculated</w> from the academy with honors after four years of hard work.
He <w>matriculated</w> from the local high school before moving to the city for his job.

traits.comment: Commonly used in South Africa to refer to completing secondary school.

senses.sense_definition: A person who has been officially admitted to a college or university.

examples.text: The university welcomed every new <w>matriculate</w> during the orientation ceremony.
Each <w>matriculate</w> is required to attend the introductory seminar on academic integrity.
